item.title: Isuzu PH Brings Relief To Earthquake-Hit Families In Sarangani
item.description: Isuzu Philippines Corporation (IPC), in partnership with Isuzu General Santos and the Local Government Unit of Barangay Burias, conducted a relief assistance activity for families affected by the recent earthquake in Glan, Sarangani. Read More »

item.title: Hyundai PH Offering Discounts Up To P1-Million This July
item.description: Hyundai Motor Philippines is celebrating 300,000 units sold in the Philippines with a slew of offers for select models including the Santa Fe, Stargazer, and Elantra. Until July 31, customers can take advantage of generous cash savings and fuel rebates. Read More »

item.title: All-New Mazda CX-5 Scores 5-Star Safety Rating In Euro NCAP, ANCAP
item.description: The all-new, third-generation CX-5 builds on Mazda’s reputation for safety with the compact SUV scoring perfect scores at both the Euro NCAP (European New Car Assessment Program) and the ANCAP (Australasian New Car Assessment Program). Read More »
